title: Who do NFL scouts think the Jets should select with the second pick in the 2026 NFL Draft?

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Who do NFL scouts think the Jets should select with the second pick in the 2026 NFL Draft?
sources.description: We are less than a week from the start of the 2026 NFL Draft. As you might imagine this time of year, the market is flooded with mock drafts. ESPN’s Matt Miller has an interesting concept. He asked scouts he was connected with across the league to make picks for teams in the top ten. […]
